answer: Reaching the ledge of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, forfeited on duplicate submission, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the relic of a task receipt, and the haven is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
